sections.summary: The person featured is Sébastien Bazin. Sébastien Bazin was PDG (CEO) of Accor as of the Accor general assembly on 28 April 2015. At the 28 April 2015 Accor general assembly, a shareholder asked Bazin whether he would accept compensation equal to the French minimum wage (SMIC), as Tesla's CEO had. Sébastien Bazin is Chief Executive Officer (PDG) of Accor, the hotel group, and has led the group since 2013. At Accor's general meeting (Wednesday, late May 2025), Bazin's mandate as PDG was renewed early for three years, until 2028; the proposal was adopted with 85% shareholder approval. His previous mandate ran until May 2026. Bazin was 63 years old as of May 2025.
